views.name: title
views.title: Lily’s Rescue Boats
views.caption: All boats home: your lifeboat charging along under the lighthouse; Play (the Rescue Service), Rally (Lily’s race), Boats, Weather, Settings

views.name: title-wide
views.title: The title, on a bigger screen
views.caption: the menu to the right, as on the boards

views.name: boats
views.title: Choose your boat
views.caption: a small drawer; behind it, the three kinds moored side by side along your pier in your crew’s colour, the camera on the one chosen: the lifeboat, good at everything; the inshore boat, quickest but bumpy alongside out at sea; the harbour launch, slow but steadiest. Lily’s five crews below

views.name: boats-wide
views.title: Choose your boat, on a bigger screen
views.caption: the drawer down the side, the boat chosen at its mooring

views.name: weather
views.title: The weather
views.caption: seven, from the boards: the title behind changes as you pick

views.name: settings
views.title: Settings
views.caption: how good the others are, which side the stick goes, sound, a new coast

views.name: start
views.title: Moored in the harbour
views.caption: as the count goes down, a look round your harbour: your lifeboat moored at the end of the pier, bows to the mouth, the town on its hill behind; a few from the town on the quay to see you off

views.name: home
views.title: Home harbour
views.caption: your harbour from above its mouth: your lifeboat at the end of the pier with its lamps and bunting, the station, timber jetties all round the basin with boats moored along them and more at their buoys, the town on the hill

views.name: harbour
views.title: Setting out
views.caption: out through the harbour, the town on its hill, the lighthouses either side of the mouth

views.name: racing
views.title: Along the coast
views.caption: your first calls are just outside the harbour; everyone rescued so far (of everyone whose call has come in), your own crew’s count, the time with the weather as it is now; the map, a little boat another crew is going for ringed in their colour; the three crews’ counts under it

views.name: steer
views.title: Touch anywhere and drag
views.caption: until you’ve steered, a faint ring low down, its dot drifting up, says how: put your finger anywhere on the sea and drag up

views.name: steer-drag
views.title: Wherever you touch is the stick
views.caption: where your finger goes down is the middle of the stick: drag ahead to go, to one side to turn, back to slow down; a faint ring where you put it; let go and she eases to a stop

views.name: north
views.title: The neighbours: North Head
views.caption: a little harbour down the coast, its breakwaters round the water in front of it, a light on the end of one; the station and its slipway at the head of the basin, a jetty, boats moored along the quays; their inshore boat at its berth

views.name: south
views.title: The neighbours: South Sound
views.caption: further down, where the coast turns away west: another little harbour, their harbour launch at its berth

views.name: line
views.title: The line goes over
views.caption: alongside and slowed right down, the little boat in the lee of the hull: the crew throws a line; the camera cuts in

views.name: climb
views.title: Climbing aboard
views.caption: held steady, the water calm in the lifeboat’s lee: a crew member leans over the rail to take a hand, and up they come

views.name: paddle
views.title: A paddleboarder
views.caption: near each harbour the first calls are the little ones: a kayaker, a paddleboarder blown out from the shore; here the neighbours from North Head, in their inshore boat

views.name: open-sea
views.title: The open sea
views.caption: past the harbour’s headland the far shore falls away: islets and reefs out over the water, the swell bigger out here; the sun going down; the neighbours’ inshore boat on its way to its next call

views.name: rough
views.title: Rough water
views.caption: out at sea, beam-on in a bigger swell: they climb across more slowly, and the bar goes amber; the harbour launch, broad and steady, has them across quicker than most

views.name: yacht
views.title: A yacht that’s lost its mast
views.caption: further out, the bigger calls: a yacht dismasted, four aboard, the mast lying along her deck

views.name: deck
views.title: A full deck
views.caption: everyone found out there, and no one left waiting: home with all ten of them

views.name: landing
views.title: Safe ashore
views.caption: in through the mouth as night comes down: they step ashore one by one, to the crowd waving on the pier by the station

views.name: their-landing
views.title: The neighbours home
views.caption: down the coast, the North Head crew come in through their breakwaters in the dusk, and land theirs on their own quay

views.name: podium
views.title: Everyone home
views.caption: everyone rescued, every crew in at its own harbour, yours at the pier; then the crews’ honours, 1st to 3rd by Lily’s rule

views.name: rally
views.title: Lily’s race
views.caption: the same coast as a race: your place and the places under the map; the last call when the first boat is home

views.name: rally-finish
views.title: The finish line
views.caption: the race’s finish: through the harbour mouth under the banner

views.name: rally-podium
views.title: 1st to 5th
views.caption: in at the quay, the places by most rescued

views.name: wide
views.title: On a bigger screen
views.caption: granite cliffs, sheltered water calmer and greener in the lee of the headlands, the wake churning white

views.name: study-inshore
views.title: The inshore boat
views.caption: a rigid inflatable: its tube in the crew’s colour, RNLI along it; the console amidships, the A-frame aft with its beacon, twin outboards

views.name: study-launch
views.title: The harbour launch
views.caption: broad and steady: its wheelhouse forward in the crew’s colour, a fat black fender all round, an open working deck aft with a davit to lift people aboard

views.name: study
views.title: The lifeboat
views.caption: navy hull, red below the waterline, RNLI along the bow; the wheelhouse in the boat’s own colour, a tall black mast; the crew in white helmets

views.name: weather-calm
views.title: Calm
views.caption: a gentle swell, little foam, gulls

views.name: weather-windy
views.title: Windy
views.caption: a bigger, steeper sea; whitecaps and streaks of foam; spray flying

views.name: weather-stormy
views.title: Stormy
views.caption: a big grey sea under a lid of cloud; rain, lightning, the beams already turning

views.name: weather-foggy
views.title: Foggy
views.caption: the coast lost in it; the lighthouses’ beams and the searchlight cut through

views.name: weather-night
views.title: Night
views.caption: stars, the moon on the water, windows lit, the beams turning, your searchlight ahead

views.name: weather-sunset
views.title: Sunset
views.caption: the sun low ahead, the sea gold and the cliffs warm

views.name: storm-wide
views.title: A storm, on a bigger screen
views.caption: the swell high enough to hide the next boat

views.name: night-wide
views.title: Night, on a bigger screen
views.caption: your searchlight on the water, the lighthouse beam sweeping the harbour mouth
